# The Next Great Canadian Country Star Competition

> The official website for a live country music competition featuring emerging and unsigned Ontario artists.

## Public website

- [Home](https://nextgreatcanadiancountrystar.com/): Competition overview, current campaign phase, shows, artists, judges, sponsors, and announcements.
- [Artists](https://nextgreatcanadiancountrystar.com/artists): Published artist profiles and the public roster.
- [Vote](https://nextgreatcanadiancountrystar.com/vote): Public shortlist voting, subject to the active voting window and email verification.
- [Artist profiles](https://nextgreatcanadiancountrystar.com/artists/): Each published artist has an individual profile URL beneath this path.

## Key facts

- The competition takes place in Peterborough, Ontario.
- The live schedule runs from January 9 to February 6, 2027: four qualifying shows followed by a Grand Final.
- Public voting requires email verification. A verified email may vote once in the public shortlist round.
- The canonical website is `https://nextgreatcanadiancountrystar.com`.
